name: Voyager 1
desc: Fastest-receding probe; flew past Jupiter and Saturn/Titan, first craft in interstellar space.
events: "Pale Blue Dot" family portrait of the Solar System
Overtook Pioneer 10 as the most distant human-made object
Crossed the heliopause into interstellar space

name: Voyager 2
desc: Grand Tour probe; the only spacecraft to visit Uranus and Neptune.
events: Crossed the heliopause into interstellar space

name: Pioneer 10
desc: First craft through the asteroid belt and first to fly past Jupiter.
events: First spacecraft to enter the asteroid belt
Crossed Neptune's orbit, leaving the planetary region

name: Pioneer 11
desc: Second Jupiter flyby, then the first spacecraft to visit Saturn.

name: New Horizons
desc: First mission to Pluto, then on to the Kuiper Belt object Arrokoth.
events: Arrokoth flyby (most distant object ever visited)

name: Parker Solar Probe
desc: Dives through the solar corona; the closest and fastest human-made object.
events: First spacecraft to fly through the solar corona
Record perihelion: 6.1 million km above the surface, 191 km/s

name: Europa Clipper
desc: NASA's Europa mission, studying whether Jupiter's ice moon could support life.

name: Psyche
desc: Electric-propulsion mission to the metal-rich asteroid 16 Psyche.
events: Trajectory ends on final approach to asteroid 16 Psyche (arrival planned 2029)

name: Lucy
desc: First mission to Jupiter's Trojan asteroids, touring eight asteroids in all.
events: Eurybates and its moon Queta flyby

name: JUICE
desc: ESA's Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer, bound for Ganymede, Callisto and Europa.
events: Jupiter arrival (end of the published trajectory)
